appDescription: A companion travel app for guardian-selected rest reminders and rest stop discovery.

function.name: FIND_REST_STOP
function.description: Open rest stop search and request a native navigation search without changing the route.

function.name: GET_REST_STATUS
function.description: Read the remaining guardian-selected rest interval and whether the journey uses vehicle signals or demo time.

function.name: CANCEL_REST_SEARCH
function.description: Cancel a pending rest stop search in PawPilot without modifying the navigation route.
